items.name: use-current-user
items.title: useCurrentUser
items.description: Typed hook that returns the current authenticated user via React Query. Reads from the Better Auth session endpoint by default; configurable.

items.name: role-gate
items.title: RoleGate
items.description: Client-side gate that renders its children only when the current user's role is in an allowed set. Pairs with useCurrentUser.

items.name: require-auth
items.title: requireAuth + getOptionalUser
items.description: Server-side auth guards for route handlers and server components. requireAuth throws 401 if there's no session; getOptionalUser returns null without throwing. Assumes a Better Auth instance at @/lib/auth.

items.name: require-role
items.title: requireRole
items.description: Server-side role guard that throws 403 (ForbiddenError) when the current user's role isn't in the allowed list. Composes with requireAuth.

items.name: auth-guard
items.title: AuthGuard (client-side)
items.description: Client-side gate that shows a spinner while loading and redirects to sign-in with a callbackUrl when there's no session. UX-only — the real gate is server-side requireAuth.

items.name: use-permissions
items.title: usePermissions
items.description: Typed `can(action, resource)` hook backed by a permission matrix you customise in the file. Plus `hasRole(...)` helper. Server-side enforcement stays in requireRole.

items.name: use-session-refresh
items.title: useSessionRefresh + broadcastSessionChange
items.description: Silent periodic session refresh + BroadcastChannel cross-tab sync. Pings the session endpoint while the tab is visible and invalidates the React Query cache; broadcasts sign-in / sign-out so every open tab updates instantly.

items.name: two-factor-setup
items.title: TwoFactorSetup (TOTP enrollment)
items.description: 3-step TOTP enrollment flow — scan QR / show secret, verify 6-digit code, display + copy + download backup codes. Wire the QR + verify endpoints to Better Auth's twoFactor plugin (or your own TOTP).

items.name: device-list
items.title: DeviceList (active sessions)
items.description: Lists every session the current user has open (device icon detected from UA, location, last-active relative time) with per-row revoke + 'sign out everywhere else' bulk action. Pair with Better Auth's session API.

items.name: impersonation
items.title: startImpersonation + stopImpersonation + resolveImpersonatedUser
items.description: Admin 'log in as user' helpers. Sets a strict, signed httpOnly cookie with a 2-hour ceiling; refuses self / owner targets; records start + stop in monitoring + optional auditLog. `resolveImpersonatedUser(actor)` wraps your auth resolver so `currentUser` returns the target while the actor's real session stays intact.
